description: Delete one project you own (project_id), or ALL your projects (all:true, which also deletes your consent record). Deletion is permanent: the archive, its tokens, its events, its event dedup/meta/reversal keys and its check state are gone. Kept: one tombstone per deleted project ({owner, deleted_at}) for 400 days so old tokens can never resurrect it, plus anonymous per-tool aggregates only (no owner or project ids). Owner credential only.
name: delete_project
title: Delete a project
